designUnit.definition: 当前正面身体基准的可见发冠至赤脚地面；含发量，不含护目镜和鞋底。

definitions.total: 刀尖至柄尾端点的直线距离；分段接缝向该长轴投影。
definitions.segments: Each central seam station projected onto straight tip-to-pommel axis; five non-overlapping axial segments sum to total. Blade/guard contact seam is blade root. Curved guard wing envelope measured separately. Grip means visible exterior part, not proven functional grip.
definitions.frontWidth: 刀身与握柄宽取垂直长轴的同一截面；护手总横向跨度单列为翼形外包宽，不混用两种量法。
definitions.thickness: 当前准入母版只有两把正面，没有EDGE；刀身侧厚和握柄侧深尚未测定，当前值为null。旧v1侧厚属于历史提案，不能当已验收值。
definitions.measurementUncertainty: 源点估读误差与设计规定分开：端点±2px、接缝±4px、距离约±4px、段长约±8px、宽约±3px。归一范围保守传播这些误差；不是统计置信区间。人物图需各自取点，不移植母版像素坐标。
definitions.bodyAlignment: 人物画布大小、护目镜高度或鞋底不得直接代替H0。姿势投影不改变设计目标，未校准的新图不标为尺寸通过。

designTargets.meaning: 总长固定；当前细分按已接受正面母版的实际轴向段与截宽归一到各自整长。v1初拟提案不作为当前实测命中结论。

sourceObservations.coordinateConvention: Image x right, y down, pixels. Straight tip-to-pommel endpoint distance L; longitudinal station is scalar projection onto that axis. No curved arc length.
sourceObservations.boundaryDefinition: Visible blade/guard contact seam midpoint; central guard/red-collar seam; collar/grip seam; grip/pommel seam. Guard wing extremes may extend above/below these central stations and are not reclassified as blade or grip.

uncertainty.note: Manual source landmarks with antialiasing and curved seam ambiguity. Extra numeric digits aid reproducibility, not claimed metrology.

guard_transverse_envelope.definition: Total transverse envelope of curved/asymmetric guard, not a single same-station section.
Total transverse envelope of curved/asymmetric guard, not a single same-station section.

sourceObservations.method: Same tip-to-pommel axis and seam-midpoint convention as observed-current-dagger-proportions.json. Width is same-station perpendicular section; guard is total transverse envelope. No curved arc length.

observations.method: Fresh target coordinates read from current whole/native head and knee; source same canonical reference landmarks reused and native reopened. Uniform scale plus translation only, no image modifications. Crown/goggle/boot distinctions maintained.

anchors.name: right visible hair crown peak, no goggles
central lower occipital hair edge, not covered neck bone
inner posterior right knee colored crease, not inferred joint center

observations.sensitivity_semantics: Signed source/target y landmark tolerance corners; not a confidence interval. Knee crease and hair shape are approximate visual anchors.

dark.limit: Terminal tip obscured by character-left hand. This visible chord is not full weapon length. Do not copy previous back endpoints or infer an exact hidden tip/ratio.

candidateObservations.meaning: 本记录保留新背面实际取点、配准残差及遮挡空值。白刀弦长仅作二维比例估计；黑刀可见弦长不是完整长度，也不是定义明确的长度下界。名义与母版尺寸不变。

superseded.reason: 用户认为原设定太小；不能作为本轮母版或人物的验收目标。
旧固定板与携行体系经母版/独立分件对照发现刀型漂移；以下记录只属于原源，不迁移到新图。

carryingDesign.definition: 后腰交叉；护手下方薄黑短托只包住短段刀根，护手坐于托口，上方束带回绕柄根，闭合带耳穿过现有腰带。刀身大部分露出。角色右黑、左骨白，交叉处骨白在外、墨黑在内。
carryingDesign.note: 局部外观及完整正、右侧、背面已通过图面审查。背面二维估读不改写母版与身体尺寸；正面柄端遮挡，完整刀长不可测，右侧只核对可见深度与遮挡，两者没有独立H0或厚度读数。动态关系尚未验证。

Rear-waist hilts are occluded; no complete front weapon length, H0 or thickness measurement.

observations.status: candidate observations; v3 artistic body-scale range acceptable, root final acceptance pending
observations.method: Uniform 2D least-squares scale plus translation only; no image modification. Actual new source landmarks inspected at native resolution.

anchors.name: visible right crown peak, not goggles
central lower occipital hair edge, not hidden neck bone
inner posterior right knee colored crease apex, not exact joint

observations.sensitivity_semantics: Signed source/target y tolerance corners; sensitivity bounds, not a statistical CI or an artistic waiver. Hair lower edge and slight leg pose mismatch produce 10.7px residual. Boots and goggles are excluded.
observations.artistic_tolerance_semantics: About5% per-weapon drawing deviation authorized by root; not manufacturing precision and not point uncertainty. Ratio is observed separately, never called exact6:7.

candidateObservations.meaning: The frozen observation was recorded before final artwork acceptance and retains that timing text. Acceptance is bound separately. These estimates do not redefine canonical dimensions or claim exact body registration.

referenceBasis.meaning: 照片投影仅启发尺寸方向；0.36H0与0.42H0是Bunny原创设计选择，不是原作武器真实长度。

designRevisions.meaning: 保留初拟分段、截宽与厚度设计。新母版对应的v2修订可按实测改变细分，旧提案不作为新图全项命中的声明。

dark.method: Each dagger normalized by its own locked total length; no image pixels are scaled. Intervals propagate source endpoint/seam/width reading bounds and are not statistical confidence intervals.

ivory.method: Each dagger normalized by its own locked total length; no image pixels are scaled. Intervals propagate source endpoint/seam/width reading bounds and are not statistical confidence intervals.

designRevisions.meaning: The accepted front master defines the current exterior part proportions. Fixed total lengths are design choices; original v1 part/thickness targets remain historical.

carryingDesign.definition: 后腰交叉；护手下方薄黑短托只包住短段刀根，护手坐于托口，上方束带回绕柄根，闭合带耳穿过现有腰带。刀身大部分露出。角色右黑、左骨白，交叉处骨白在外、墨黑在内。
carryingDesign.note: 固定研究板与正、右侧、背面均按母版刀型完成修订。三视是手绘概念近似，非严格正投影；侧面白刀尖比背面约高37px，柄尾高度残差约27px，记录为绘制差异。背面骨白端点可估读，墨黑刀尖被手遮挡，完整刀长为空；当前图面估读不改写母版与身体服装尺寸。
